name: Needling Topspike
description: Feel along the edge of a breastplate with the top spike to find the seam before driving in.

name: Pummelthrash
description: Drag the studs across a mail sleeve and tear at the rings to open it for the heavier blow.

name: Unyielding Shaftcollar
description: Lift the shaft with both hands across the face to take a cut on the wood and the iron cap.

name: Ballleap
description: Pace slowly around a heavily armored foe, keeping the ball out of reach of his grasping hands.

name: Harpooning Headspike
description: Concentrate qi into the leading spike and drive it into a plate junction with a boring twist of the shaft.

name: Crunchassault
description: Strike the side of a helm with a short qi-loaded swing so the shock rattles the skull inside.

name: Rupturing Spikebase Onslaught
description: Bring the loaded head down in a heavy fall that drives its spikes through a plate and splits the metal along the seam.

name: Ballbarrage
description: Drive a spike through mail and twist the shaft, tearing a wound that makes the foe drop his guard.

name: Splitting Spikering
description: Lift the head from below the waist to above the crown in a single rising pull before it falls.

name: Maulthrash
description: Let the lifted head fall straight down onto the crown of the target with the full weight of the arms.

name: Steadfast Spikebase
description: Hold the shaft flat above the head to cover the crown against a descending cut.

name: Burrpounce
description: Step to the foe's blind side during the lift so the fall arrives from an unexpected angle.

name: Aura Studcrush
description: Stretch the qi field into the head just before the fall so it arrives heavier than it looks.

name: Burrtorment
description: Land a striking blow whose qi rings through the helm and skull for a moment after the head lifts.

name: Thistleassault
description: Keep qi flowing through the shaft so the head, rebounding from a blow, returns for a second crown strike.

name: Crippling Headspike
description: Smash the head into a raised weapon so hard the foe's arms buckle and his guard falls open.

name: Ravaging Studcrush
description: Gather qi along the whole shaft before the stroke, then release it all as the head falls on the crown.

name: Interlocking Pummel
description: Hammer the same crown spot three times in a row, each fall carried by the rebound of the one before.

name: Trouncing Ballsocket
description: Tap the rim of a shield with the head to learn how it is held and how it is braced.

name: Crunchtorment
description: Knock the head into the central boss of a shield so the arm behind it is jarred.

name: Hardened Ballsocket
description: Keep the shaft diagonal in front so splinters and glancing blows fall away from the body.

name: Thistlecanter
description: Slide along the edge of the foe's shield, away from his weapon hand, while the head swings free.

name: Manacling Spikering
description: Hook a spike over a shield board and drag it down to open the foe's face.

name: Maulassault
description: Hit the top rim of the shield so the spikes bite and the board is yanked toward the user.

name: Scorching Headspike
description: Smash the loaded head into the bracing arm behind a shield, so the shield sags even when the board holds.

name: Stifling Thornball
description: Drive a rapid series of short qi-edged knocks along a shield line, shaking loose the grip of each bearer.

name: Subduing Prickball
description: Lodge two spikes in a shield board and haul it sideways so the foe is turned against his own cover.

name: Thistlethrash
description: Swing a fully loaded head onto the iron boss of a shield and shatter the fittings, leaving the board useless.

name: Raging Spikedrop
description: Pin the shield under the head, then drive a second qi-heavy blow so the bearer crumples behind his cover.

name: Ballthrash
description: Fix the eye on one point of the target before the swing and let the head find it.

name: Immovable Headspike
description: Pull the head back on its arc to put the shaft in the path of a thrust.

name: Pummelspurt
description: Shift the front foot a few inches as the head descends, so the landing is square.

name: Nimbus Topspike
description: Dab the top spike into the target as a light probe before committing the full qi.

name: Facet Prickball
description: Draw the field of qi into the leading spike so it lands as one hard point rather than a spread of studs.

name: Lancing Spikeball
description: Aim the gathered spike at the gap in the armpit and push so the wound is deep and narrow.

name: Enduring Ballsocket
description: After a deep landing, release the field back into the shaft so it forms a stiff guard before the foe can strike.

name: Quelling Shaftcollar
description: Seat the gathered spike deep in the foe's armor and keep qi flowing through the shaft so he cannot pull free.

name: Needling Spikering
description: Hold the gathered field at the spike for a breath, then let the head fall and place the point through the foe's armor.

name: Resilient Spikering
description: Stand with the shaft raised on a slant so one hand guards while the other prepares the stroke.

name: Thistlebarrage
description: Swing the orb in a curving path like a river bend so it lands around an expected guard.

name: Crunchjaunt
description: Slide both hands apart along the shaft as the foot steps, lengthening or shortening the lever.

name: Granite Topspike
description: Drop the head into the hollow behind a guard, as water falls into a basin.

name: Unshaken Shaftcollar
description: Use the second track of motion in the shaft to turn a cut aside while the head is still moving.

name: Dominating Spikeball
description: Swing the head to hook the foe's weapon while the haft crosses it from below, locking the blade between the two.

name: Maulbarrage
description: Run one stream of qi through the shaft for the guard and one into the head for the blow.

name: Pummeltorment
description: Strike twice in the same place in one beat, so the second blow lands as the first one rings.

name: Siltcrunch
description: Sweep a broad qi-heavy arc from low to high like a river meeting the sea, striking all foes in reach.

name: Annealed Ballsocket
description: Raise the shaft as a guard, then drop the head from the same motion onto the foe who attacks it.

name: Harrowing Prickball
description: Lift the head high over the shoulder like a hawk on a thermal, waiting for the moment to stoop.

name: Crunchbarrage
description: Drop the head steeply and fast onto the target from above, in the manner of a diving hawk.

name: Burrassault
description: Skim the head close to the ground and bring it up under the opponent's lead knee.

name: Staunch Thornball
description: Spread both arms and the shaft like a pair of wings, covering the chest and head together.

name: Gustmaul
description: Glide on light feet, shaft carried level, to meet a charging foe from the side.

name: Silencing Topspike
description: Catch the foe's sleeve on a curved spike like a talon and hold on as he tries to pull free.

name: Compounding Spikering
description: Strike high with the stoop and low with the skim in one paired motion, so the foe's guard splits in two.

name: Unflinching Headspike
description: Beat the shaft against an incoming blade like a pinion feather, turning it harmlessly aside.

name: Lambasting Studcrush
description: Gather qi as the head rises and let it all fall into the stoop, so the blow seems to double in weight.

name: Nimbus Spikedrop
description: Rake a qi-edged spike down the foe's guard arm like a talon, tearing the grip away from the weapon.

name: Successive Pummel
description: Gather qi for a breath, then loose two hawk stoops in one beat, the second falling where the first opened the guard.

name: Iron Prickball
description: Smash the head down on the foe's shoulder while the shaft pins his weapon arm, so he cannot lift either.

name: Mantled Spikering
description: Stand with feet apart and the shaft before the chest, steady as the rim of a basin.

name: Ravaging Headspike
description: Let the head flow in a continuous curve from one side to the other, never stopping at the turn.

name: Ballsprint
description: Cut across the foe's line with a long pace that carries the head with it.

name: Transfixing Topspike
description: Tap two spikes in quick succession into the same gap in the armor, widening it.

name: Hardened Spikebase
description: Send one stream of qi along the haft and one around the head, so both shaft and orb turn blows.

name: Maultorment
description: Strike with the head while the second stream of qi lifts the shaft for the next swing.

name: Drubbing Studball
description: Fill the head with both streams of qi at once and drive it into the foe like a sudden flood.

name: Tiered Crunch
description: Carry a swing across the foe and back in a single flow of qi, each stroke fed by the one before.

name: Adamant Shaftcollar
description: Stand at the edge of open ground with the shaft angled low, ready to move in any direction.

name: Thistletorment
description: Swing the head overhand in a long clean arc, using the reach of the whole shaft.

name: Crunchspurt
description: Cover ground in a long stride so the swing lands just as the foot comes down.

name: Hamstringing Spikedrop
description: Hook a spike on the foe's belt as he passes and haul him off his line.

name: Skinning Ballsocket
description: Let a gust of qi carry the head round after a miss and bring it back from the opposite side.

name: Lancing Studball
description: Lunge at the full length of the shaft and press a single spike through the foe's guard at the far end of the swing.

name: Immovable Prickball
description: Spin the shaft in a quick circle that kicks up a blast of qi and throws cuts wide.

name: Blazemaul
description: Sweep the head in a wide level arc, loaded with qi, to strike every foe within the long reach of the shaft.

name: Alternating Pummel
description: Chase a retreating foe with strides and swings linked together, never giving him room to set his feet.

name: Unbroken Headspike
description: Lay the shaft along the line to the foe's chest, holding the bearing before any swing begins.

name: Furrowing Thornball
description: Swing the head along the held bearing so it lands precisely on the sighted spot.

name: Thistlejaunt
description: Pivot on the lead foot to keep the bearing fixed on a foe who circles.

name: Harpooning Spikebase
description: Check the aim by touching a spike to the foe's armor before the real stroke.

name: Staunch Topspike
description: Slip the head aside from a thrust and re-take the bearing as the blade passes.

name: Grinding Prickball
description: Return the head along the very same line it left on, striking a foe who has stepped into it.

name: Cleaving Spikering
description: Send qi down the held bearing so the falling head lands exactly where the user is looking.

name: Compressing Shaftcollar
description: Keep the shaft pressed along the foe's bearing so every move he makes is met by the haft.

name: Surging Thornbite
description: Step across the foe's bearing and take a new line while the head is still in motion.

name: Tempered Topspike
description: Hold the bearing through a full breath of gathered qi, then loose the head so a single spike lands true.

name: Funneling Studcrush
description: Chain three strikes along the same bearing, each retaking the line before the foe can shift off it.

name: Rupturing Prickball
description: Open with a swing struck as if sworn, committing the full length of the shaft to the target.

name: Enduring Shaftcollar
description: Brace the shaft against a strong wind of attack, feet wide, head low and ready.

name: Maulleap
description: Step out to the full reach of the shaft, so the head touches the foe before his weapon can.

name: Wrecking Ballsocket
description: Rake the head back across the opponent's ribs after the first swing, never leaving the line sworn.

name: Trouncing Headspike
description: Breathe in as the head lifts and out as it falls, so the whole stroke rides one breath.

name: Unmaking Spikebase
description: Send all the qi of the swing into the head at the last moment, as if keeping a vow made to the wind.

name: Staggering Topspike
description: Hook the foe's shield rim at full reach and pull it aside so the next swing finds him open.

name: Resilient Thornball
description: Beat a cut away with a flash of qi in the haft, turning the whole shaft in a quick circle.

name: Raging Slag Thornbite
description: Gather the qi of a long breath and crash the head down at the full reach of the shaft, loaded with all of it.

name: Downpour Spikering
description: Whirl the head in a level ring around the body, wind trailing it, striking all within the arc.
